defects.what: count ignores skipped dates, so skipping a date adds one at the end.
Weekly rules produce listed weekdays earlier in the start week, before the start date.
Weekly rules ignore the interval and repeat every week.
add_months never moves to the next year, so a monthly rule jumps from December back to January of the same year.
A day missing from a short month is moved to the month's last day instead of skipped.
